U.P. Rajeev Appointed Director of Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre

U.P. Rajeev has been appointed as the new Director of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC). Dr. Rajeev brings extensive experience in rocket control and guidance to this role. He has previously led mission designs and simulations for major launch vehicles of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). This appointment marks a significant leadership change within a key ISRO facility.
